## Code Example
```yaml
name: Verify image provenance
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
jobs:
  verify-image:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up cosign
        run: |
          curl -sSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sigstore/cosign/v1.6.0/cosign-linux-amd64 -o cosign
          chmod +x cosign
      - name: Verify image provenance
        run: |
          ./cosign verify ghcr.io/tenant/registry/service:latest --certificate cosign.pub
```

- What metrics and dashboards would you use to detect tampering early?

## Why This Is Asked

## Code Example

```javascript
function verifyWebhook(payload, signature, key) {
  const h = require('crypto').createHmac('sha256', key).update(payload).digest('hex');
  return require('crypto').timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(h, 'hex'), Buffer.from(signature, 'hex'));
}
```
